intro.text: An Arelene mourning custom dating from before the Reod, in which a lady who has just lost her husband does works of charity.

description.text: The time and effort a widow gives to her trial are a measure of her regard for her late husband and their marriage. Most hand out food or other basic needs to the poor.

Because the custom grew out of the old reverence for the Elantrians, some call it a pagan rite. Sarene's priest, Father Omin, and many other Korathi accept it, since it means giving to the needy rather than worshipping Elantrians.

items.text: Sarene asked Father Omin what a Widow's Trial involves.

She chose to make her trial a gift of food to the Elantrians, to undercut Hrathen's campaign against them, and asked the nobles to join her; only Shuden agreed. Iadon gave his permission in exchange for a profitable trade deal with Teod.
With Eondel and Shuden as escort, Sarene brought food into Elantris and bargained with its leaders to hand it out unhindered, in return for cloth, grain, oil and building materials.
